candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.sender==owner) check so the modifier no longer restricts access to the owner.
Change the amount withdrawn from the full contract balance to the depositsCount value.
Transfer 0 instead of the requested _value amount.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw performs no ether transfer.
Send the transfer to the contract's owner instead of msg.sender.
Transfer the entire contract balance instead of the requested _value amount.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can call withdraw.
Remove the require(__sent_result100) check so sendMoney no longer reverts when the low-level call fails.
Remove the require(msg.sender==owner) check so any caller can execute withdrawAll, withdraw, and sendMoney.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners (all addresses other than the owner) may pass the modifier.
Replace the low-level call to _target with a direct transfer of _value to msg.sender, so funds go to the caller instead of the target.
